content.text:
MSCI has **$85,002 thousand** (about $85.0 million) of operating lease payments due over the next three years (2025 through 2027). That is **about 51.3%** of its $165,605 thousand in total undiscounted operating lease payments. These figures come from the lease maturity table in its 10-K for fiscal 2024, which was the latest 10-K filed as of 16 May 2025.

| Year | Operating lease payments ($ thousands) |
|---|---|
| 2025 | 30,220 |
| 2026 | 30,361 |
| 2027 | 24,421 |
| **Next 3 years total** | **85,002** |
| 2028 | 23,931 |
| 2029 | 16,573 |
| Thereafter | 40,099 |
| **Total lease payments** | **165,605** |

- **Percentage:** 85,002 ÷ 165,605 = **51.3%** of total undiscounted lease payments.
- **Present-value basis:** After subtracting $19,601 thousand of interest, the lease liability is $146,004 thousand. The table only lists payments before discounting, so the 51.3% is based on those amounts, not on the present value.

**Sources**
- MSCI Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2024, filed 2025-02-07, accession 0001408198-25-000053 (table "Maturity of Lease Liabilities").
